title: HidePlayer
description: Hide players from tab list only - body remains visible in-game
body:
## What It Does

✅ Player hidden from TAB list

✅ Player body VISIBLE in world

✅ Chat works (no errors)

✅ Full interaction possible

## Features

Tab list only hiding

No chat validation errors

Persistent after rejoin

Admin bypass & see hidden

YAML & SQLite storage

Fully configurable

Hex color support

Sound notifications

Lightweight

No dependencies

## How It Works

Hidden = NOT in TAB list

Body = VISIBLE in game

Chat = WORKS normally

## Commands

/hp hide [player] - Hide from tab

/hp show [player] - Show in tab

/hp toggle [player] - Toggle visibility

/hp list - List hidden players

/hp status [player] - Check status

/hp reload - Reload config
